messages.content: I’ll use the battery to sell into the late-afternoon peak, carry high-paying down-regulation awards in the evening, and restore the required end-of-day charge. I’ll check feasibility before locking the day-ahead book, then manage it through the live watches.

The final commit refused the hour-8 charge for a slight SoC overrun, which also prevented the intended hour-16 discharge and hour-17 reserve awards. Those reserve awards are now unavailable for the day. I’ll repair the energy schedule in real time and continue monitoring the plant.
ERCOT has deployed Non-Spin, but we hold no Non-Spin awards. The hour-16 and hour-17 discharges are frozen and remain in place; no schedule change is needed at this notice watch.
